origin: Drive archived MQR-4.95 P3 source bundle (not new GBIF download)

date_encoding.range_duration_interpretation: Interval notation means an observation date/time range; an interval of one day is NOT evidence of two visits.

coordinate_ambiguity.statement: Repeated matching geographic/time fields are NOT certified identical-site independent revisit events.

in_sample_posthoc_date_format_rule.description: PREDICT ABSENT if / interval else PRESENT; simple post-hoc descriptive rule on original raw eventDate
in_sample_posthoc_date_format_rule.comparison_original_author_csv: eventDate missing from 23-column Serov model CSV. This rule cannot be called an original author model shortcut or evaluated heldout performance.

research_limits: The 2024 original ZIP is occurrence-core TSV, not certified event-core full sampling-event archive.
Missing eventID/locationID/sampling effort columns in THIS exact ZIP do not prove the upstream publisher never held richer survey files.
Source status and date representation are highly associated but causal source behavior, true occupancy and detection rates are not identified.
ISO 8601 interval encoding is standard and not an error by itself.
Do not equate 0 strict candidates with 0 actual revisits.
Data originally preserved by MQR4.95; not independently collected new field observations.
